hotspots.label: Aorta
hotspots.description: The main artery carrying blood out of the heart

hotspots.label: Superior vena cava
hotspots.description: Returns deoxygenated blood from the head, neck and arms to the right atrium

hotspots.label: Pulmonary trunk
hotspots.description: Carries deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs

hotspots.label: Right atrium
hotspots.description: Receives venous blood from the body via the venae cavae

hotspots.label: Left atrium
hotspots.description: Receives oxygenated blood from the four pulmonary veins

hotspots.label: Right ventricle
hotspots.description: Pumps blood through the pulmonary valve to the lungs

hotspots.label: Left ventricle
hotspots.description: Thick-walled chamber pumping oxygenated blood into the aorta

hotspots.label: Coronary arteries
hotspots.description: Supply the heart muscle itself; the LAD runs in the anterior interventricular groove

hotspots.label: Inferior vena cava
hotspots.description: Returns blood from the lower body to the right atrium

hotspots.label: Apex
hotspots.description: Tip of the left ventricle — the apex beat (left 5th intercostal space)

hotspots.label: Trachea
hotspots.description: Carries air from the throat to the lungs

hotspots.label: Right main bronchus
hotspots.description: Wider, shorter and more vertical — inhaled objects usually lodge here

hotspots.label: Left main bronchus
hotspots.description: Longer and more horizontal, passing under the aortic arch

hotspots.label: Right upper lobe
hotspots.description: Separated from the middle lobe by the horizontal fissure

hotspots.label: Right middle lobe
hotspots.description: Wedge between the horizontal and oblique fissures (right lung only)

hotspots.label: Right lower lobe
hotspots.description: Largest lobe; auscultated over the posterior chest

hotspots.label: Left upper lobe
hotspots.description: Includes the lingula, the left counterpart of the middle lobe

hotspots.label: Left lower lobe
hotspots.description: Separated from the upper lobe by the oblique fissure

hotspots.label: Cardiac notch
hotspots.description: Indentation of the left lung accommodating the heart

hotspots.label: Diaphragmatic surface
hotspots.description: Concave base of the lung resting on the dome of the diaphragm

hotspots.label: Frontal lobe
hotspots.description: Planning, personality, voluntary movement and (left) speech production

hotspots.label: Central sulcus
hotspots.description: Separates the motor (precentral) from the sensory (postcentral) gyrus

hotspots.label: Parietal lobe
hotspots.description: Somatosensory processing and spatial awareness

hotspots.label: Occipital lobe
hotspots.description: Primary visual cortex

hotspots.label: Temporal lobe
hotspots.description: Hearing, memory (hippocampus) and language comprehension

hotspots.label: Longitudinal fissure
hotspots.description: Deep cleft separating the two cerebral hemispheres

hotspots.label: Cerebellum
hotspots.description: Coordinates movement, balance and posture

hotspots.label: Brainstem
hotspots.description: Midbrain, pons and medulla — vital centres for breathing and heart rate

hotspots.label: Corpus callosum
hotspots.description: Thick band of fibres connecting the hemispheres (use cross-section)

hotspots.label: Renal cortex
hotspots.description: Outer layer containing the glomeruli that filter the blood

hotspots.label: Renal pyramids
hotspots.description: Medullary cones of collecting ducts (use cross-section)

hotspots.label: Renal pelvis
hotspots.description: Funnel collecting urine from the calyces into the ureter

hotspots.label: Renal artery
hotspots.description: Brings ~20% of cardiac output to the kidney

hotspots.label: Renal vein
hotspots.description: Drains filtered blood into the inferior vena cava

hotspots.label: Ureter
hotspots.description: Muscular tube carrying urine down to the bladder

hotspots.label: Adrenal gland
hotspots.description: Endocrine gland on the upper pole: cortisol, aldosterone, adrenaline

hotspots.label: Abdominal aorta
hotspots.description: Gives off the renal arteries at the level of L1/L2

hotspots.label: Inferior vena cava
hotspots.description: Receives both renal veins

hotspots.label: Right lobe
hotspots.description: Largest lobe, under the right dome of the diaphragm

hotspots.label: Left lobe
hotspots.description: Thinner lobe extending across the epigastrium

hotspots.label: Falciform ligament
hotspots.description: Peritoneal fold attaching the liver to the anterior abdominal wall

hotspots.label: Gallbladder
hotspots.description: Stores and concentrates bile

hotspots.label: Common bile duct
hotspots.description: Carries bile to the duodenum

hotspots.label: Hepatic portal vein
hotspots.description: Brings nutrient-rich blood from the gut (75% of liver inflow)

hotspots.label: Hepatic artery proper
hotspots.description: Supplies oxygenated blood (25% of inflow)

hotspots.label: Caudate lobe
hotspots.description: Small posterior lobe beside the IVC

hotspots.label: Inferior vena cava
hotspots.description: Receives the hepatic veins behind the liver

hotspots.label: Oesophagus
hotspots.description: Muscular tube delivering swallowed food to the stomach

hotspots.label: Cardia
hotspots.description: Region around the oesophageal opening

hotspots.label: Fundus
hotspots.description: Dome above the cardia; often holds swallowed air

hotspots.label: Body
hotspots.description: Main part where food is mixed with acid and pepsin

hotspots.label: Greater curvature
hotspots.description: Long convex lateral border; attachment of the greater omentum

hotspots.label: Lesser curvature
hotspots.description: Short concave medial border; common site of gastric ulcers

hotspots.label: Pyloric antrum
hotspots.description: Grinds food and regulates emptying

hotspots.label: Pylorus
hotspots.description: Sphincter controlling passage into the duodenum

hotspots.label: Duodenum
hotspots.description: First part of the small intestine

hotspots.label: Gastric rugae
hotspots.description: Folds of mucosa that flatten as the stomach fills (use cross-section)

hotspots.label: Cornea
hotspots.description: Clear dome that provides most of the eye's focusing power

hotspots.label: Iris
hotspots.description: Pigmented muscular ring controlling pupil size

hotspots.label: Pupil
hotspots.description: Aperture letting light into the eye

hotspots.label: Lens
hotspots.description: Changes shape to focus near and far (accommodation)

hotspots.label: Sclera
hotspots.description: Tough white outer coat of the eyeball

hotspots.label: Retina
hotspots.description: Light-sensitive layer of rods and cones (use cross-section)

hotspots.label: Optic nerve
hotspots.description: Carries visual signals to the brain

hotspots.label: Superior rectus
hotspots.description: Elevates the eye (CN III)

hotspots.label: Lateral rectus
hotspots.description: Abducts the eye (CN VI)

hotspots.label: Inferior rectus
hotspots.description: Depresses the eye (CN III)
